cases.assertion: Two authorized participants can invite, accept, exchange SDP and ICE in role order, and hang up. No unrelated session receives media signaling.
A simultaneous caller receives busy. Reject, cancel and a 30-second ring timeout release both memberships for the next independent call.
A nonparticipant or a blocked pair cannot send or receive signals. An unselected same-account device cannot join negotiation.
A signed-in client receives deployment ICE URLs and scoped expiring TURN credentials, and the shared server secret is never included.
